label: November 2026
subject: BFCM week: what to leave alone
preview: A core update during peak season, clarity beats countdown timers, and the deadlines waiting in January.
intro: Black Friday is November 27 and Cyber Monday is November 30. This issue is short on purpose. The best thing most stores can do this week is stop changing things.

sections.heading: A core update is rolling out during peak season
sections.short: A core update during peak season
paragraphs: Google started its November core update on November 10. Rankings may move around for a couple of weeks, right as holiday traffic peaks.

Do not respond by rewriting pages or changing URLs mid-rollout. Let it finish, then compare full weeks. Meanwhile, more buyers are checking deals through AI assistants and price trackers, which reward clear, honest pricing more than clever copy.
sections.pullquote: During a core update in BFCM week, the best SEO move is usually no move.

sections.heading: Clarity beats countdown timers
paragraphs: Holiday buyers are comparing more stores than usual, and they are tired of fake urgency. What actually moves them is certainty: the real discount, the real delivery date, and what happens if the gift does not fit.
If you change only one thing this week, make your delivery cut-off and return window visible near the buy button.

sections.heading: Shopify changes worth knowing
paragraphs: Nothing here needs action this week. These are dates to put in the calendar for January.

bullets.text: Apps must move to expiring offline access tokens before January 1, 2027. If you use custom or private apps, ask whoever built them whether they are ready.
bullets.label: Shopify changelog

bullets.text: POS receipts customised with the Liquid editor need to move to the new unified receipt template by January 1, 2027.
bullets.label: Retail roundup

bullets.text: Shop Promise claims for earlier qualifying orders close on December 16.
bullets.label: Shopify changelog

sections.heading: Final checks before Friday
bullets: Place a full test order with your sale discount applied, on a phone.
Check stock levels on your top ten products and set low-stock alerts.
Confirm who is watching orders and support messages over the weekend.
Freeze theme and app changes until December 1.

closing: Good luck this week. After the weekend, reply and tell me one thing that worked and one that did not. I will share what merchants learned in December's issue.
